# DarkWing Studio

> DarkWing Studio is an independent creative studio building open-source software, web tools, and digital 3D artwork. DarkWing Studio is the official online hub for its open projects, creative experiments, 4K digital wallpapers, and verified social channels.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/): Official DarkWing Studio homepage and link directory.
- [About](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/about/): Studio philosophy, solo background, and creator profile.
- [Projects](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/projects/): Software, web experiments, and open-source GitHub repositories.
- [Art](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/art/): Digital art showcases, 3D renders, and visual creations.
- [Art Assets](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/art/assets/): Downloadable 4K wallpapers and profile avatars.
- [Arcade Hub](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/arcade/): DarkWing Studio arcade games listing.
- [T-Rex Runner](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/arcade/t-rex-runner/): Endless runner canvas game with offline PWA support, day/night cycle, and zero external libraries.
- [Minecraft Database](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/minecraft/mobs/): Minecraft mob compendium with stats, drops, and lore.
- [Changelog](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/changelog/): Chronological release log of studio updates, feature additions, and technical milestones.
- [Privacy Policy](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/privacy/): Static hosting, contact data, cookie transparency, and privacy disclosure.
- [Terms of Use](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/terms/): Personal wallpaper download license, MIT code license, and copyright notices.

## Brand Assets
- [Social Graph Image (JPG)](https://darkwingstudio.netlify.app/assets/og-image.jpg): Universal 1200x630 social sharing preview card (< 100 KB).

## Official Channels
- [GitHub](https://github.com/DarkWingStudio): Open-source projects and code.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@DarkWing-in): Development videos and tutorials.
- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/darkwingstudio.in/): Official visual content.
- [Pinterest](https://www.pinterest.com/Darkwingstudio): Art, wallpapers, and visual references.
- [X](https://x.com/DarkWingStudio): Updates and development notes.
- [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/user/darkwingstudio): Community discussions and releases.
- [DeviantArt](https://www.deviantart.com/darkwingstudio): Digital artwork and gallery collections.

## Content and Architecture
- The site has no advertising, third-party analytics, or tracking cookies.
- Hosted statically with strict Content Security Policy and zero server-side runtimes.
- The Arcade section uses localStorage exclusively to persist game high scores on-device; no data is transmitted to any server.
